subject: how an economic change moves from where it arises into a place, and what a region is for that purpose

boundary_types.ADMINISTRATIVE: a jurisdiction. An observation unit, and not automatically an economy.
boundary_types.LABOR: the set of places connected by where people live and where they work
boundary_types.HOUSING: a market in which the same dwellings compete for the same buyers
boundary_types.SUPPLY_CHAIN: the places an input passes through on its way to a use
boundary_types.ENERGY: a production, refining and distribution system
boundary_types.FINANCIAL: a set of lenders, borrowers and claims
boundary_types.PROCUREMENT: who buys from whom under what rules
boundary_types.INSTITUTIONAL: a set of organisations whose decisions bind on each other
boundary_types.MARKET: a set of buyers and sellers of one thing
boundary_types.RESEARCH: a boundary drawn for one question and not claimed beyond it

boundaries.name: Los Alamos County
boundaries.purpose: the jurisdiction, as a publisher of statistics defines it
boundaries.why_economically_meaningful: It is the unit almost every published statistic uses, which makes it the unit a reader will assume. That is a reason to state it explicitly, not a reason to treat it as an economy.
known_blind_spots: it contains one dominant employer and most of that employer's workforce lives elsewhere, so county-level aggregates describe a workplace rather than a community

boundaries.name: Santa Fe County
boundaries.why_economically_meaningful: Household income, housing and local taxation are administered at this boundary even where the economy that produces the income is not inside it.
known_blind_spots: a substantial share of its residents' earnings is produced at a workplace outside it

boundaries.name: The Los Alamos labour region
boundaries.purpose: the set of counties that directly exchange a material share of workers with Los Alamos
external_dependencies: whoever funds the employers inside it
boundaries.why_economically_meaningful: Where someone works and where they live are different places here, and the counties that supply that workforce experience a change in Los Alamos employment directly, through their own residents' income. The boundary is drawn by that relationship rather than around it.
known_blind_spots: earnings by origin county are not held at this resolution
residents who work outside New Mexico are not in this table
it is a labour boundary and says nothing about housing or credit

boundaries.name: The Doña Ana commuting set
boundaries.purpose: the set of counties that directly exchange a material share of workers with Doña Ana
external_dependencies: whoever funds the employers inside it
boundaries.why_economically_meaningful: A substantial share of the jobs located in Doña Ana are filled from another state, which makes it the clearest held case of an economic relationship that an administrative boundary cuts through. The relationship is the finding; the set is not a system.
known_blind_spots: NOT A FUNCTIONAL REGION. None of the 5 non-seed members exchanges a material share of workers with any other. A change in one of them reaches the hub and stops. It is a STAR, which means a change in one member cannot reach another through this structure. The boundary is declared so the relationship can be asked about; it is not a system.
earnings by origin county are not held at this resolution
residents who work outside New Mexico are not in this table
it is a labour boundary and says nothing about housing or credit

measures.DEPENDENCE: what share of the DEPENDENT side's economy this edge is. A share with a named denominator.

threshold_sensitivity.reads_as: The region is reported at one threshold and its sensitivity beside it. A reader who prefers another threshold can see what they would get.

transitive_dissolution.finding: Direct connection puts 4 counties in Los Alamos's labour region. Allowing 4 rounds of indirect connection puts 23 there. The second number is not a bigger region; it is the connected component of the state's commuting graph.
transitive_dissolution.why_it_matters: A transitive rule would report something close to New Mexico for every seed, which would look like the discovery that the state is a labour region and would actually be the discovery that the graph is connected.

gate_vs_hinge.TRANSMISSION_GATE: a parameter or relationship that controls WHETHER, and how much of, an upstream change crosses a boundary. It is a property of the crossing.
gate_vs_hinge.HINGE: an economically consequential shared quantity where world, place and development reasoning meet. It is a property of the local economy, and it has to be a quantity somebody here actually faces.
gate_vs_hinge.they_can_coincide: Regional fuel pass-through is a gate. Delivered cost per stop is the hinge downstream of it. The gate decides how much arrives; the hinge is the thing whose level changes a local decision.

top_down_vs_bottom_up.finding: Top-down from a world price lands on a multi-state refining region. Bottom-up from a county lands on a labour region of neighbouring counties. They do not meet, and they are not supposed to: they are different circuits. The disagreement is preserved because reconciling it would mean asserting a connection between a fuel price and a commuting pattern that nothing registers.

adversarial.attack: These 'regions' are administrative boundaries with a new label.
adversarial.finding: No county was assigned to any region by hand. Each is the set the commuting relationships reached from a seed. The Doña Ana region contains ['Doña Ana', 'El Paso, TX', 'Hidalgo', 'Luna', 'Otero', 'Sierra'], which includes a Texas county and excludes most of New Mexico; the Los Alamos region contains 4 counties. Neither is a jurisdiction.

adversarial.attack: Geography was chosen before the economic relationship.
adversarial.finding: Both labour regions and the energy geography carry a provenance field. The energy one is the clearest: PADD III was not selected, it is where the registered walk landed, and no step of the procedure names it in advance.

adversarial.attack: The paths skip intermediate actors.
adversarial.finding: The first version of the path object carried only variables. It now carries intermediate_actors and each prototype names them, but this is honestly thin: the energy path names two actor KINDS and the model observes no decision either of them takes. actors.yaml refuses that inference by construction, so the actors are present and unobserved.

adversarial.attack: The paths skip intermediate geographies.
adversarial.finding: The energy path reports its intermediate geographies and the decisive one is PADD III (includes New Mexico), which is reported as multi-state rather than collapsed into New Mexico.

adversarial.attack: A national variable is being substituted for local incidence.
adversarial.finding: No prototype claims a local level from a national series. The energy path is marked direction_only because PASS_THROUGH is UNKNOWN, and the construction path stops at its gate.

adversarial.attack: A multi-state observation is being called New Mexico.
adversarial.finding: PADD III is labelled 'includes New Mexico' everywhere it appears, and the energy prototype's note names this as the substitution 10I attack 16 withdrew.

adversarial.attack: Flow volume is being confused with dependence.
adversarial.finding: The labour prototype reports both against named denominators and they disagree in the way that matters: Santa Fe supplies 24.4% of Los Alamos's jobs but that is 7.5% of its own working residents, while Rio Arriba supplies 8.7% and that is 16.5% of its own. By volume the answer is Santa Fe; by dependence it is Rio Arriba.

adversarial.attack: Dependence is being confused with centrality.
adversarial.finding: They are separate functions with separate denominators. centrality() returns a COUNT of counterparties above a stated threshold and says in its own output that it is not a weighted score.

adversarial.attack: Transmission is being called propagation.
adversarial.finding: The only propagation object in this phase follows an intervention inside a declared boundary, which is the RDM sense PIERCE-07 retained. Every world-to-place object is a transmission path.

adversarial.attack: Propagation is being called transmission.
adversarial.finding: classify() returns INTERNAL rather than PROPAGATION for an event with both ends inside a boundary, precisely so that movement inside a system is not promoted to a post-intervention claim by accident. INTERNAL says it is eligible to be read as propagation after an intervention and with a counterfactual.

adversarial.attack: The classification would change under another boundary.
adversarial.finding: That is the design, and it is Proof 1. One event classifies four ways across four declared boundaries and is stored once.

adversarial.attack: Retention is defined without a flow.
adversarial.finding: retention() refuses without a flow from a closed vocabulary, and refuses without a denominator and a boundary.

adversarial.attack: Leakage is defined without a denominator.
adversarial.finding: This attack found a real defect. The first version of the region discovery computed 'share of the sender's working residents' for every county in the table. For an out-of-state county this table observes only the residents who work in New Mexico — a median of three — so the share was ~100% by construction and the discovered region contained 1,776 out-of-state counties. residents_denominator() now returns None where the denominator is invalid, and the valid alternative is the receiving county's own job count. The 43,638 jobs supplied from outside New Mexico are still counted, against a denominator that exists.

adversarial.attack: Capture is being confused with retention.
adversarial.finding: They are separate kinds and capture is refused without an actor, with the refusal message saying it is otherwise a retention claim wearing a different word. No capture claim is made in this phase: no actor-level evidence exists.

adversarial.attack: Pass-through is assumed rather than measured.
adversarial.finding: PASS_THROUGH is UNKNOWN in both price prototypes and term() refuses to record OBSERVED or ESTIMATED without a value. The energy path reports 1 observed term of seven.

adversarial.attack: Direction is being confused with magnitude.
adversarial.finding: Each path carries direction_only, which is True wherever PASS_THROUGH is not observed. Both price prototypes are direction_only.

adversarial.attack: A price path is standing in for a quantity or income path.
adversarial.finding: The labour prototype is explicitly non-price: what crosses is work and the income attached to it, and its hinge is household earned income.

adversarial.attack: A functional region is inferred from one edge.
adversarial.finding: The attack was right about one of them and this phase withdraws the claim. Testing whether a discovered set's members connect to EACH OTHER and not only to the seed: the Los Alamos set has 5 edges among its 3 non-seed members and is a CONNECTED_REGION. The Doña Ana set has 0. Every one of its members connects to Doña Ana and to no other member, so a change in Hidalgo reaches the hub and stops. By this phase's own definition — sufficiently connected that a change can materially reach the others — it is a STAR and NOT a functional region. The cross-state relationship with El Paso survives as a bilateral labour relationship, which is what the evidence actually supports.

adversarial.attack: Overlapping regions are being collapsed.
adversarial.finding: systems_for() returns 2 systems for Santa Fe with different, non-nesting geographies, and Santa Fe's own labour region is not the same set as the Los Alamos labour region it belongs to.

adversarial.attack: A network is being forced into a polygon.
adversarial.finding: No polygon is produced anywhere in this phase. A region is a SET of county codes plus the edges that put them there, and the edges are reported.

adversarial.attack: Propagation is assumed positive.
adversarial.finding: The prototype contains a DISPLACEMENT effect — an existing processor losing the volume the new capacity takes — and a TRANSIENT utilisation effect whose note says zero propagation lives there.

adversarial.attack: Persistence is being called compounding.
adversarial.finding: effect() refuses COMPOUNDING unless it names the later action that becomes cheaper. Of 6 effects, 1 is compounding and the rest are retained, transient or displacement.

adversarial.attack: Correlation after an intervention is being called attribution.
adversarial.finding: Every effect carries an attribution field derived from whether a counterfactual exists. None does, so the prototype's attribution is ATTRIBUTION_UNKNOWN and the object says in its own text that nothing in it asserts that any of it happened.

adversarial.attack: An unavailable observation is actually governed.
adversarial.finding: Carried forward from 10I, which routes acequia, district, Tribal and Pueblo records to GOVERNED before any ranking can reach them. This phase adds no acquisition list of its own.

adversarial.attack: Acquisition is justified by completeness rather than information value.
adversarial.finding: This phase acquired nothing. The one new dataset it reads — county names — was already in the repository as a boundary file downloaded in an earlier phase.

adversarial.attack: Top-down traversal disagrees with bottom-up traversal.
adversarial.finding: It does, and the disagreement is the finding rather than a defect. Top-down from Brent lands on PADD III (includes New Mexico); bottom-up from Santa Fe lands on a labour region of neighbouring counties. They are different circuits and the comparison object preserves the disagreement rather than reconciling it.

adversarial.attack: The chosen boundary changes the economic interpretation.
adversarial.finding: It does, measurably. The same wage flow is 24.4% LEAKAGE under Los Alamos County and 84.5% RETENTION under the labour region, on the same denominator.

adversarial.attack: The path does not actually reach a valid hinge.
adversarial.finding: Each prototype names a hinge and each hinge passes the six-field requirement — but all three are NAMED_NOT_MEASURED. The path reaches a hinge in the sense that it identifies the quantity; it does not reach an observed one, and the phase should not be read as claiming otherwise.

adversarial.attack: The hinge does not change local economics.
adversarial.finding: Not settleable here. Delivered cost per stop plausibly decides whether a small buyer is on a route at all, and nothing held measures that. The hinge carries its downstream consequences as named claims, not as evidence.

adversarial.attack: The evidence stops earlier than the prose.
adversarial.finding: This is the attack this phase most needed. Every path now reports first_unsupported_edge and evidence_stops_because, and the prototypes stop at DIESEL_US -> TRUCK_PER_MILE_COST and CONSTR_INPUTS_PPI -> MATERIAL_PASSTHROUGH_NNM. The labour hinge is named and unmeasured. Where the prose continues past those points it is describing what would have to be observed, not what is.

refusals.refuses: a federal-economy functional region for New Mexico
refusals.why: NM_FEDERAL_OUTLAYS is registered, unobserved, and has no outbound relationship. The discovery procedure returns NO FUNCTIONAL SYSTEM IDENTIFIED. In the state most exposed to federal spending this is the most interesting system Dula could describe, and it has no path.
refusals.prevents: a regional story assembled from the importance of the subject rather than from evidence

refusals.refuses: a pass-through magnitude on either price path
refusals.why: PASS_THROUGH is UNKNOWN in both. The decomposition terms are not multiplied and no coefficient is produced.
refusals.prevents: a direction being read as an elasticity

refusals.refuses: any attribution claim in the propagation prototype
refusals.why: no counterfactual exists for any effect, so every one reads ATTRIBUTION_UNKNOWN.
refusals.prevents: temporal sequence being read as causality

refusals.refuses: a retention, leakage or capture claim with no flow, denominator or boundary, and a capture claim with no actor
refusals.why: retention() raises rather than returning a weaker object.
refusals.prevents: '63% stays local', which is not a claim until it says 63% of what, inside what

refusals.refuses: treating a county as an economic system because statistics are published for it
refusals.why: the administrative boundaries declared here say in their own why_meaningful field that they are observation units, and Los Alamos County's blind spot records that most of its dominant employer's workforce lives outside it.
refusals.prevents: a county profile being mistaken for a system reading

refusals.refuses: a labour region built by chaining indirect connections
refusals.why: the commuting graph is connected, so transitive expansion returns most of New Mexico from any seed. That result would look like the discovery that the state is a labour region and would be the discovery that the graph is connected.
refusals.prevents: the administrative unit arriving as a conclusion

refusals.refuses: calling the Doña Ana set a functional labour region
refusals.why: zero edges run among its five non-seed members. It is a hub with spokes, and a change in one spoke cannot reach another through it. The cross-state relationship with El Paso County, Texas is real and is kept as a bilateral relationship.
refusals.prevents: a set of bilateral relationships being presented as a system

refusals.refuses: any share of an out-of-state county's working residents
refusals.why: this table observes only the residents of those counties who work in New Mexico — a median of three per county.
refusals.prevents: the 1,776-county region the first version of the discovery produced

reading.lede: The same 4,436 jobs are an outflow from one county, an inflow to another and an internal transfer inside the labour region that contains both. Dula can now say which, because it can declare the boundary it is reasoning about — and once it can, a county stops being an economy and becomes one way of cutting one.
defining: Of the two labour sets discovered from commuting flows, one is a connected region and one is a star that this phase refuses to call a region.
The same wage flow is 24.4% leakage or 84.5% retention depending on the boundary, on one denominator.
Santa Fe belongs to 2 systems whose geographies do not nest, so there is no single region it is in.

beats.claim: The same economic event is an outflow, an inflow and an internal transfer at the same time.
beats.says: 4,436 jobs held by Santa Fe residents at workplaces in Los Alamos read as 4 different classifications across four declared boundaries, from one stored record.
beats.because: Transmission, inflow, outflow and internal movement are not properties of an event. They are properties of an event relative to a boundary, and until a boundary is declared none of those words means anything.
beats.consequence: Any claim that value leaves a place, or stays in it, carries a boundary whether or not it states one. This phase makes stating it compulsory.

beats.claim: A county is not an economy, and the labour evidence says so directly.
beats.says: 24.4% of the jobs in Los Alamos are held by Santa Fe residents and 8.7% by Rio Arriba residents. Measured the other way those edges are 7.5% and 16.5% of the sending county's own working residents.
beats.because: Volume and dependence have different denominators. By volume the answer is Santa Fe; by dependence it is Rio Arriba, which is more than twice as reliant on Los Alamos as Santa Fe is.
beats.rival: That one of the two numbers is the real one. Neither is: they answer different questions, and which matters depends on whether you are asking what would happen to Los Alamos or what would happen to Rio Arriba.
beats.consequence: A reading built on volume alone would have named the wrong county as the one with most at stake.

beats.claim: The region was discovered from the relationships, not chosen in advance — and one discovered set turned out not to be a region.
beats.says: The Los Alamos set has 5 edges among its 3 non-seed members and is a CONNECTED_REGION. The Doña Ana set has 0: every member connects to the hub and to no other member.
beats.because: This phase's own definition requires that a change can reach the OTHERS. In a star it cannot — it reaches the hub and stops.
beats.rival: That the Doña Ana set is a region with a dominant centre. The test does not distinguish those two readings by assertion; it counts the edges, and there are none.
beats.consequence: The cross-state relationship with El Paso County, Texas survives as a bilateral labour relationship, which is what the evidence supports. The six-county region does not.
beats.unknown: Whether the spokes are connected through something other than commuting — shared suppliers, a common buyer — is not observable here.

beats.claim: Allowing indirect connections would have produced New Mexico, and called it a discovery.
beats.says: Direct connection puts 4 counties in Los Alamos's labour region. Allowing 4 rounds of indirect connection puts 23 there. The second number is not a bigger region; it is the connected component of the state's commuting graph.
beats.because: A transitive rule would report something close to New Mexico for every seed, which would look like the discovery that the state is a labour region and would actually be the discovery that the graph is connected.
beats.consequence: The default is direct connection. The transitive result is reported beside it so the choice is visible rather than buried in a parameter.

beats.claim: The same wages are 24% leakage or 85% retention depending on where the line is drawn.
beats.says: Measured against the same denominator — all 18,206 jobs located in Los Alamos — the wages earned by people living elsewhere are 24.4% LEAKAGE under the county boundary and 84.5% RETENTION under the labour region.
beats.because: Retention is a property of a flow relative to a boundary. Neither number is wrong and neither travels without saying which boundary it used.
beats.consequence: A local-retention figure quoted without its boundary and its denominator is not a finding. It is two choices and an arithmetic.
beats.unknown: Both are counted in JOBS. Earnings by origin county are not held, so this is the share of jobs whose wages go elsewhere and not the share of the wage bill.

beats.claim: There is no answer to what region a place is in without saying what economic process is being asked about.
beats.says: Santa Fe participates in 2 systems whose geographies do not nest: a labour region of neighbouring counties, and an energy system whose relevant unit is PADD III (includes New Mexico). Its own labour region is also not the same set as the Los Alamos labour region it belongs to.
beats.because: A functional region is specific to a circuit. Labour and fuel travel through different relationships and arrive at different geographies.
beats.consequence: REGION FOR WHAT is a required qualifier, not a stylistic one.

beats.claim: Walking down from the world and walking up from a place do not meet, and that is the finding.
beats.says: Top-down from Brent reaches PADD III (includes New Mexico). Bottom-up from Santa Fe reaches a labour region of neighbouring counties. They share nothing.
beats.because: Top-down from a world price lands on a multi-state refining region. Bottom-up from a county lands on a labour region of neighbouring counties. They do not meet, and they are not supposed to: they are different circuits. The disagreement is preserved because reconciling it would mean asserting a connection between a fuel price and a commuting pattern that nothing registers.
beats.consequence: Reconciling them would mean asserting a connection between a fuel price and a commuting pattern that nothing registers. The disagreement is preserved.

beats.claim: Thirty attacks ran against this phase and two of them changed what it claims.
beats.says: One found that the region discovery computed shares against a denominator that does not exist for out-of-state counties, which had produced a labour region containing 1,776 of them. The other found that a discovered set was a star rather than a region.
beats.because: Both were defects in method rather than in prose, and both were found by running a test rather than by rereading the text.
beats.consequence: The out-of-state jobs are still counted, against the receiving county's own job total, which is a denominator this table actually supplies.

beats.claim: What should follow an intervention can be stated; whether it did cannot.
beats.says: The propagation prototype carries 6 expected effects across three orders, of which 1 is compounding, one is displacement and one is transient. Its attribution is ATTRIBUTION_UNKNOWN.
beats.because: An effect may only be called compounding if it names the later action that becomes cheaper. Persistence alone is retention, and a change after an intervention is not attributable to it without a counterfactual.
beats.consequence: The one measurement that would test the compounding claim — the fixed cost faced by the next venture — is the one nobody collects.
beats.question: Which of the three named hinges is worth measuring first, given that all three require fieldwork that field/PROTOCOL.md governs?

most_consequential_unknown.why_it_limits: Every retention and dependence figure here is counted in JOBS. The question people actually ask — how much income stays — needs earnings by where the worker lives, and LODES at this resolution does not carry it. A county whose residents hold many low-paid jobs elsewhere and one whose residents hold few high-paid ones look the same here.
most_consequential_unknown.would_resolve: LODES earnings segments or QWI earnings by residence, neither of which is held at county-pair resolution
